{{Top}}
'''Second Lieutenant''' was a lesser grade of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], below [[First Lieutenant/Legends|First Lieutenant]]. It was used in the military forces of various [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] governments, including the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. This rank was also used for [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] placed above a [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant-Major]] but below a Lieutenant. Like Lieutenants, 2nd Lieutenants could command a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]], and had blue markings in the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] also used the rank.

[[Kyle Katarn]] served as a Second Lieutenant in the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]].<ref name="DF:SftE">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> [[Alfonso Luiz Obota]] was a Second Lieutenant in Rebel Alliance [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Special Operations]] and [[Momo]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="DF:JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref> [[Hurati]] was a Second Lieutenant in the CIS before his promotion to captain.<ref name="RC:HC">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>
